name: Dove Soft Ltd
lot: 1,200 shares (min 2 lots / 2,400 shares = ₹2,66,400 at upper band)
lm_rationale: Swastika Investmart Ltd. has no 2026 SME-tracker record on chittorgarh (search returned "No data available"), but ipomarkets.com's multi-year track record shows 44 IPOs handled (43 SME + 1 mainboard), +12.1% average listing gain across 36 listed issues — a long, broadly positive record, though 2 of its most recent listed SME issues (Siddhi Cotspin -20.0%, Aten Papers & Foam -6.3%) were negative.
fund_use_text: Working-capital only (100% of ₹46.00 Cr net proceeds funds working capital, balance general corporate purposes)
ronw: 29.79% (RHP calls it RoNW/ROE interchangeably; FY26 figure)
de: 0.10 (FY26 Debt/Equity per RHP KPI table); chittorgarh shows 0.13, the FY25 figure
nav: ₹47.43 (FY26, RHP Basis for Offer Price p101); chittorgarh's KPI table shows ₹35.02, the FY25 NAV
pbv: 2.34 (111/47.43, using FY26 NAV); chittorgarh's 3.17 uses the stale FY25 NAV of ₹35.02
eps_pre: 12.01 (basic, FY26) / 11.78 (diluted, FY26); chittorgarh shows 12.28, a slightly different pre-issue EPS calc
eps_post: 9.60 (post-issue EPS per chittorgarh, using FY26 PAT ₹2,340.42 lakh / 2,43,86,755 post-issue shares = ₹9.60, consistent)
pe_pre: 9.04 (chittorgarh, 111/12.28); using RHP's own basic EPS of ₹12.01, pre-issue P/E = 9.24x
promoter_pre: 73.21% (Promoters 60.98%... actually 73.21% incl. promoter group per RHP p49-51; chittorgarh's Shareholding Structure table shows 74.32%, a slightly different aggregation)
promoter_post: 53.73% (chittorgarh); RHP leaves post-offer promoter % as [●] pending final allotment, so chittorgarh's figure is its own post-issue-shares-based estimate, not an RHP-disclosed number
net_proceeds: ₹46.00 Cr of the ₹59.14 Cr fresh issue is earmarked for working capital (the RHP leaves the exact Net Proceeds and General Corporate Purposes amounts as [●], to be finalised at Prospectus stage; General Corporate Purposes is capped at 15% of Gross Proceeds or ₹10 Cr, whichever is lower). The ₹14.12 Cr OFS (6,36,000 shares each from promoter-sellers Rahul Bhanushali and Sky Occean Infrastructure Ltd.) goes to the selling shareholders, not the company.
key_risks: Working capital intensity is rising fast: trade receivables grew from ₹53.54 Cr (FY24) to ₹100.99 Cr (FY26) as the company shifted toward enterprise clients with longer credit cycles, while trade payables grew more slowly, widening the net working-capital gap from ₹17.81 Cr to ₹58.63 Cr over the same period. Total borrowings also rose from ₹2.54 Cr (FY24) to ₹9.30 Cr (FY26, RHP capitalisation statement figure of ₹9.2978 Cr pre-offer).
market_moat: Dove Soft is a CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) aggregator offering SMS, RCS, Voice/IVR, WhatsApp Business API and email delivery to enterprises and OTT platforms across Telecom, IT, Travel, Media, Retail, BFSI, Automobile and other sectors, acting as an intermediary between telecom operators and corporate clients.
management: Promoters Kurjibhai Rupareliya, Rahul Bhanushali and Sky Occean Infrastructure Ltd.; combined promoter + promoter group holding is 73.21%+1.11% pre-issue per the RHP's detailed shareholder table (chittorgarh's rounder 74.32%/53.73% Pre/Post IPO figures are also shown, sourced from a different RHP table).
prose_business: Dove Soft provides integrated cloud-communication (CPaaS) solutions — SMS, RCS, Voice, WhatsApp Business API, Email and other digital channels — to enterprises and OTT platforms across Telecom, IT, Travel, Media, Retail, Real Estate, Healthcare, BFSI, Automobile and E-commerce. FY26 revenue from operations was ₹273.98 Cr (standalone) / consolidated Total Income ₹274.74 Cr, per the RHP.
highlight_dev: The company plans to use the bulk of net proceeds (₹46.00 Cr) to fund working capital, enabling it to negotiate better bulk-purchase pricing and credit terms with telecom operators/vendors and to offer bank guarantees — addressing a structural cash-conversion gap as its client mix shifts toward larger enterprise accounts with longer payment cycles.
sector_outlook: No dedicated third-party industry-size figures were found in the RHP text sampled; the RHP frames Dove Soft as a CPaaS/aggregator business serving the growing enterprise digital-communications market in India, citing its own 66% revenue CAGR (₹35.58 Cr FY22 to ₹273.98 Cr FY26) as the primary growth narrative rather than citing an external TAM estimate.
gov_scheme: None disclosed in the RHP sections reviewed.
peer_sentence: The RHP names two listed peers — Route Mobile Ltd (FY26 revenue ₹4,408.21 Cr, diluted EPS ₹37.94, P/E 13.21x, RoNW 9.72%, NAV ₹447.85) and Tanla Platforms Ltd (FY26 revenue ₹4,417.71 Cr, diluted EPS ₹38.36, P/E 13.58x, RoNW 20.46%, NAV ₹187.61) — both far larger than Dove Soft (FY26 revenue ₹273.98 Cr, diluted EPS ₹11.78). Dove Soft's own P/E is left as [●] in this peer table since the RHP predates price-band finalisation; based on the disclosed offer price of ₹111 and FY26 diluted EPS of ₹11.78, its implied pre-issue P/E of 9.42x is below both listed peers' 13.21x-13.58x range.
verdict_reason: FY26 revenue and PAT both grew strongly (+45.94%/+41.44%), and the 11.56x post-issue P/E is a discount to listed CPaaS peers Route Mobile and Tanla (13.2-13.6x), but working capital (receivables) is expanding faster than revenue and chittorgarh's KPI/NAV figures on this page are a year stale versus the RHP's own FY26 numbers.
why: Dove Soft's FY26 consolidated Total Income rose 45.94% to ₹274.74 Cr and PAT rose 41.44% to ₹23.40 Cr, continuing a 3-year uptrend (FY24 ₹119.79 Cr/₹10.27 Cr). ROE was 29.79% and ROCE 36.50% in FY26 (RHP MD&A figures), versus the older 33.12%/42.14% chittorgarh's KPI table displays (that table is dated "Mar 31, 2025", i.e. FY25, not FY26). At the ₹111 upper band, post-issue P/E is 11.56x versus listed peers Route Mobile (13.21x) and Tanla Platforms (13.58x) — a discount, though EPS growth has come with rising receivables (₹53.54 Cr to ₹100.99 Cr over FY24-FY26). Net proceeds go entirely to working capital, no debt repayment or capex named. Promoter holding falls from roughly 73-74% to about 54% post-issue. Lead manager Swastika Investmart has a long multi-year record (+12.1% avg listing gain, 36 listed) but its two most recent listed SME mandates were negative on listing day.
suggestion: Watch: the growth and valuation-versus-peers case is reasonable, but confirm the FY26 (not FY25) KPI figures before applying, and note the widening working-capital gap as the key risk to monitor post-listing.
documents: drhp-cache/dove-soft-rhp.pdf (Red Herring Prospectus dated 22 Sep 2026; cached at Obsidian Vault/drhp-cache)
discrepancies: chittorgarh's Company Financials table (274.74/23.40/32.78/70.69/70.18/6.29) matches the RHP's consolidated restated figures for FY26 (Total Income 274.74, PAT 23.40, EBITDA 32.78) closely, though chittorgarh's 'NET Worth' of ₹70.69 Cr and 'Reserves and Surplus' of ₹70.18 Cr sit close to, but not identical to, the RHP's own MSME-eligibility table net worth of ₹70.6853 Cr (rounds to same figure) and Reserves and Surplus of ₹70.1758 Cr (matches, rounding).

chittorgarh's KPI table (ROE 33.12%, ROCE 42.14%, D/E 0.13, PAT Margin 8.81%, EBITDA Margin 12.86%, NAV ₹35.02, P/BV 3.17) is explicitly headed 'Mar 31, 2025' — i.e. it is the FY25 column of the RHP's own KPI table, not FY26. The RHP's FY26 KPI figures (ROE 29.79%, ROCE 36.50%, D/E 0.10, PAT Margin 8.54%, EBITDA Margin 11.96%, NAV ₹47.43) are more current and are what this card uses.

chittorgarh's IPO Valuation table (EPS Pre ₹12.28, EPS Post ₹9.60, P/E Pre 9.04x, P/E Post 11.56x, Market Cap ₹211.55 Cr pre / ₹270.69 Cr post) is internally consistent with the RHP's FY26 PAT of ₹2,340.42 lakh divided by pre-issue shares (1,90,58,755) = EPS ₹12.28, matching. The RHP's own Basis for Offer Price section instead shows Basic EPS ₹12.01/Diluted EPS ₹11.78 for FY26 — a small difference likely due to a slightly different weighted-average-shares convention (bonus/split adjustment) versus chittorgarh's straight pre-issue-share-count division. Both are reported; the RHP's own figure is preferred where they diverge.

The RHP's Basis for Offer Price section leaves Industry Peer Group P/E for Dove Soft itself as [●] since the RHP predates the price band; using the now-known ₹111 upper price against RHP's own diluted EPS of ₹11.78 gives a pre-issue P/E of 9.42x, close to chittorgarh's 9.04x (which uses the ₹12.28 EPS denominator instead).

chittorgarh's Shareholding Structure shows Promoter/Promoter Group Pre-IPO 74.32%, Post-IPO 53.73%. The RHP's own detailed pre-offer table (p51) sums Promoters (73.21%) + Promoter Group (1.11%) = 74.32%, matching chittorgarh's pre-issue figure exactly. The RHP leaves ALL post-offer shareholding cells as [●] since price band/allotment were not finalised at RHP stage, so chittorgarh's 53.73% post-issue figure is chittorgarh's own derived estimate (not literally present in the RHP text), not a discrepancy but worth flagging as non-RHP-sourced.

No material litigation, criminal proceedings, or regulatory action is disclosed against Dove Soft, its promoters, or its subsidiary (Dove Soft Technologies Pvt Ltd) in the RHP's Outstanding Litigation section.

Net Proceeds and General Corporate Purposes amounts are left as [●] throughout the RHP's Objects of the Offer section — only the ₹46.00 Cr working-capital line item is a hard number; the exact Net Proceeds and GCP split await the Prospectus/price-band-ad stage.
